newsitem.title: GERMANY: Armed man takes hostage in German bank.
newsitem.headline: Armed man takes hostage in German bank.

text.p: An armed robber took one person hostage in a Munich bank on Thursday morning, German police said.

A police spokesman said the man had entered the bank in the southern city's Harlaching district at around 8.30 a.m (0730 GMT) and was holding the hostage inside the building. No further details were immediately available.
The incident came almost exactly a year after Munich police had to deal with two hostage dramas within 24 hours.
They first stormed a bank where an armed man was holding three people hostage for a ransom of four million marks ($2.8 million). All the captives and the hostage-taker were unharmed.
Hours later they shot dead a man who threatened to kill his girlfriend and a policeman. The man fired at police after they came to investigate a domestic row .
He then grabbed an officer who tried to stop him fleeing and held him captive for half an hour.
